name: THE PATRONS
note:
Four men AND the table they are sitting at, as ONE sprite. Tyler asked whether the furniture should come out of the plate and be regenerated with the men attached, and he was right: a table and the men at it are one object, and splitting them across a plate and a sprite needs endless patching. As a foreground plane the table would draw over everything, so Thad walking in FRONT of it would be covered by it; as one sprite at one anchor he passes behind or in front of it for free.
Built from two pieces that already existed: the men, drawn by pointing the generator at this plate so their seated height and angle match this table; and the table itself, cut from the OLD plate by differencing it against a companion with the table removed -- so the cut is the table’s own shape, not a rectangle.

sprite.note: Still, for now. A card game is the stillest thing in the room and an idle can come later from a second draw of the same four men.
